company.name: JobAlchemist
company.description:
JobAlchemist is a Y Combinator-backed startup that builds online recruiting software. 

Their products include job board software that powers both niche destination sites such as Startuply and white label sites redditJobs and Homeby3, and JobSyndicate, a job affiliate network.
